records.name: Stored representative visibility for identity-backed filteredSet contains/remove
records.verification: Read current source SPDX header, visible(Collection,Predicate,Object), and module LICENSE; source content hash recorded
records.candidate_approach: Reuse existing M3FilteredViews stored-representative pattern: first require backing membership; for Set prioritize the identical stored reference; apply predicate to the actual stored member. Mutable filteredSet remove must remove the resolved stored representative only when visible, following the target owner contract.
records.complexity: Existing visible helper: backing contains cost plus up to two linear traversals; O(1) retained auxiliary state. Target mutation cost depends on backing set.
records.semantic_mismatch: M3FilteredViews itself is read-only and remove throws UnsupportedOperationException; reuse its representative-resolution pattern, not its mutation behavior. Testing predicate on an equals-equal probe/alias, or using an equals-only scan for an identity-backed set, can choose the wrong object. Do not claim target integration complete from this research record.
records.source_line_evidence: visible at lines 118-136; CollectionView.contains at 154; SetView.contains at 171; remove at 156/174 remains read-only.

records.name: Stable primitive comparator permutation sort
records.license: Apache-2.0 plus source CERN sorting/binary-search notice
records.verification: Pinned source and license fetched with GitHub connector
records.candidate_approach: Future candidate: stable comparator sort an int ordinal map with comparator reading payload through mapped indices; preserve incoming encounter order for ties.
records.complexity: Inspected merge sort: O(m log m) worst-case comparisons, O(m) support storage; derived from implementation, not a benchmark.
records.semantic_mismatch: Natural primitive stableSort may delegate to unstableSort; comparator overload calls mergeSort. Source is a generation template. Original payload-index tie breaks may alter chained stable-sort semantics. No new sorting change selected.

records.name: Comparator duplicate lower/upper-bound semantics
records.verification: Pinned source and license fetched with GitHub connector
records.candidate_approach: Reference FIRST_PRESENT/LAST_PRESENT/FIRST_AFTER/LAST_BEFORE; future local ordinal-map bound helpers can expose [lower,upper).
records.complexity: O(log m) comparator operations with O(1) indexed access; Guava copies non-RandomAccess lists, adding O(m) work/storage.
records.semantic_mismatch: Package-private internal class, not supported public API. Comparator equality does not imply Objects.equals, so cannot directly replace List contains/indexOf. No bound change selected.

records.name: Dense acceptance mask with word prefix counts
records.license: Platform API reference only; no JDK source transplant proposed
records.verification: Official BitSet and Long API pages opened
records.candidate_approach: Future candidate: explicit logical domain n, long acceptance words and exclusive word-prefix population counts using Long.bitCount; selected positions address incoming view ordinals.
records.complexity: Design-derived: ceil(n/64) mask words; O(n/64) prefix construction; O(1) rank with per-word counts; O(log(n/64)+64) select using prefix search and within-word scan.
records.semantic_mismatch: BitSet has no public indexed rank/select; length is highest set bit + 1, not logical domain length. Final-word masking, empty states, 63/64 boundaries and shift-by-64 behavior require explicit handling. No mask change selected.

records.name: Compressed Java bitmap rank/select
records.verification: Pinned source and license fetched with GitHub connector
records.candidate_approach: Conditional future alternative for compressed membership, traversal and rank/select; measure complete wrapper behavior before choosing.
records.complexity: Inspected rankLong/select scan high-level containers: O(c + chosen-container operation), c = visited containers; no universal O(1) or speed claim.
records.semantic_mismatch: Rank is inclusive (<=x), select ordinal is zero based, integers are unsigned 32-bit positions. Enforce Java valid ordinals and adapt rank convention; compression overhead is workload-dependent. Not used this pass.

records.name: Native compressed bitmap rank/select

records.candidate_approach: Conditional future native bitmap candidate only after end-to-end measurement; rank_many supports batched ascending queries.

JNI error translation/lifecycle required. Arbitrary Java predicate/comparator callbacks cannot run inside a JNI critical-array region. Not used this pass.

invariants: Evaluate visibility on stored representative, not lookup probe.
Identity-backed set membership cannot be replaced by equals-only membership.
A filtered ordinal map F composes parent map P and selected incoming ordinals K as F[j]=P[K[j]].
Acceptance masks address incoming view ordinal positions, not physical payload indices when parent has a permutation.
Stable comparator ties preserve incoming encounter order; physical source-index tie-break can alter chained sorts.
Preserve live/snapshot backing behavior, callback timing, duplicates/null policy, exceptions, mutation support, and iterator interference policy.
No throughput, memory, JNI or complexity improvement for current M3 target is claimed by catalogue selection.

target_defect.problem: Inherited equality-based lookup/removal can select an equals-equal different stored object in an identity-backed Set, or accept an absent equals-equal probe.
target_defect.selected_fix_shape: Respect backing membership identity; resolve the actual stored representative; apply visibility predicate to that stored representative; remove that representative only when visible.
target_defect.implementation_owner: collection_inventory; actual target changes and tests are owned by that agent, not this research record
